# The Stayers

The Stayers are Riftborn who want to keep living in the Severed Lands. Their movement is strongest in Nexus, where workshops, families and neighborhood institutions make that choice concrete. Many also support another person's right to leave through a genuinely safe Door.

Their local-born children are people of this world, with normal local lives and deaths, regardless of their parents' origins. They cannot follow a parent to an outside body they do not have. Some families accept a departure; others feel abandoned. Neither reaction is a faction-wide rule.

In Rift Awakening, Stayers argue for containment, informed consent and protection of native lives. They need not endorse V's secrecy or an indefinite shutdown of elective return. Their disagreement with Returners concerns the terms and risks of an operation, not whether one desire is the morally correct way to live.
